representativeSourceSet.binding: The frozen package contains a nested :not(:matches(...), ...) selector at ordinal 357; the exact closing-parenthesis regex-class case is a capability fixture because no frozen rule contains that rarer literal yet.

legadoSemantics.implementation: AnalyzeByJSoup delegates CSS group selection to Jsoup Element.select and QueryParser.
legadoSemantics.groupBoundary: Only commas outside quoted, escaped, attribute and pseudo-argument contexts split selector groups.
legadoSemantics.identity: Distinct nodes remain distinct even when their outer HTML is equal.

failureCondition: Matcher.splitByComma counts every parenthesis and bracket with one integer. A ) inside [)] decrements the outer pseudo depth, so a comma still inside :matches can be emitted as a top-level group boundary.
